db.heroTitle: Official Taiko no Tatsujin chart database
db.noCharts: The database has no charts yet
db.searchPlaceholder: Search titles, translations, Nijiiro ID or official ID
db.deleteText: The chart record is removed from the database. Files still used by other charts are kept.
db.uploadNeedsPermission: This account does not have the upload permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.
db.uploadNeedsSignIn: Sign in with an account that has the upload permission.
db.uploadWaveHint: The TJA's WAVE must name the chosen audio file. Once stored, WAVE is rewritten to the audio's hash file name.
db.tjaTooLarge: The TJA must not be empty or exceed 2 MiB
db.audioTooLarge: The audio must not be empty or exceed 100 MiB
db.noFilesText: This song is registered, but its TJA and audio have not been uploaded yet.
db.noFilesManagerText: This song is registered, but its TJA and audio have not been uploaded yet. Once uploaded, the title, subtitle, BPM and difficulties come from the TJA.
db.uploadChartFilesText: Choose this song's TJA and its audio. Once stored, the title, subtitle, BPM and difficulties come from the TJA and replace what was entered before.
db.replaceWaveHint: When the current audio is kept, the TJA's WAVE can name any file; once stored it is rewritten to the audio's hash file name.
db.songOnlyText: A song can be registered before its files are at hand: enter its title and what is known, and upload the TJA and audio later from the song's page. A registered song does not appear in the game.
db.songFieldsHint: The title is required; the subtitle and BPM may be left empty. Once files are uploaded, these come from the TJA.
db.songFieldsInvalid: The title must not be empty; the BPM must be a positive number or empty.
db.identifierHint: Both identifiers are optional. The Nijiiro ID is a positive integer; the official ID may contain letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
db.identifierInvalid: The Nijiiro ID must be a positive integer; the official ID may contain letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, up to 64 characters.
db.categoriesHint: Select any number; none means unclassified.
